summary: No blocking correctness or usability problem was found in the simple LoRA notebook workflow.
scope: Colab L4 training from the pinned public SFT train/dev/validation splits with two secrets, native LiquidAI/LFM2.5-230M, frozen-base PEFT LoRA, assistant-only loss, W&B loss reporting, and final adapter/tokenizer/card upload to a model repository.

checks.result: The notebook and helper hashes match the round-3 report. The embedded helper AST equals lora_training.py. All code cells have no execution count or saved outputs.

checks.check: Independent encoding of all cached public rows
checks.method: Executed the notebook config, helpers and data cells with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 and token=False in /tmp/rewriter-training-check. The cache directory contains the configured dataset revision bbcdb7692445a4310296060606b8a6dcce439f47.
checks.result: All 1,184 rows encoded without truncation. Decoding the supervised labels with special tokens removed exactly reproduced each assistant target.

Source inspection confirms native AutoModelForCausalLM loading at the pinned model revision, PEFT LoRA with no trainable bias or modules_to_save, prompt/padding loss masking, train-only optimization, dev-only checkpoint selection, and one validation evaluation after training. The pinned Transformers 5.21.0 implementation accepts warmup_steps=0.05 as a ratio. W&B receives Trainer loss logs and the explicit final validation loss.

Inspected the checker and bound round-3 report. The report records four actual optimizer steps on a tiny random native LFM, changed adapter parameters, unchanged frozen base weights, exact saved-adapter reload, offline W&B validation logging, and a mocked model upload. The saved adapter config identifies LoRA, the pinned base revision, and no modules_to_save.

The notebook reads only HF_TOKEN and WANDB_API_KEY from Colab Secrets. It saves the adapter, tokenizer and card to final_adapter. Upload validation rejects base weight files and source files, and push_adapter explicitly uses repo_type=model. The separate dataset publisher allows only Parquet splits, dataset cards and source-license notices. It keeps code, review records and logs out of the dataset payload.

limitations: This review did not run an L4 GPU or load the actual 230M base weights. Colab installation and GPU memory use remain unverified by this review.
This review did not perform online W&B logging or an actual model upload. The saved CPU integration uses offline W&B and a mocked upload.
The all-row encoding check read the existing public-data cache at the pinned revision. It did not refresh Hub metadata or inspect the current public dataset tree online.
The prior CPU optimizer run was inspected through its checker, report and saved adapter artifacts. The full training checker was not rerun during this review.
This verdict covers implementation correctness within the stated workflow. It does not establish semantic rewrite quality or independent human validation.
reviewer_changes: Only this review report was added. No implementation, examples, datasets, credentials or remote model artifacts were changed.
